AC4.evidence: 2013 Prima guide matchup matrix; does not establish an actionable in-game eligibility flag, script API, animation timing or input priority

caveats.description: The guide describes Brute melee-attack counter input redirecting to a dodge, not ordinary counter follow-up; briefly vulnerable back can be attacked
The guide describes Captain vulnerable to held defensive parry leading to a stun kick; standard counter kills resisted

Same guide prose suggests prone after two successive Break Defense uses on Captains, but its summary matrix marks Captain immune to Break Defense. This is an unresolved SOURCE CONTRADICTION, not a resolved combat rule
A Scout is marked immune to a normal Attack but weak to Combo Kill and Kill Streak; never treat normal attack and completed combo finisher as the same effect

ACBFR.evidence: Ubisoft July 7 gameplay explanation: conceptual enemy defense, parry, weapon and environment conditions; in-game eligibility API and exact 1.0.6 status UNKNOWN

safety_invariants: An archetype matchup label is NOT an executable eligibility boolean.
An official patch note asserting 'fixed' is NOT a proof the owner's actual game binary is matching or defect-free.
A fix first listed in 1.0.7/1.0.8 is NOT assumed present in 1.0.6; absence of a note does not prove absence of underlying behavior.
Never treat AC4 enemy archetype classes as equivalent to identically named Resynced archetypes.
Do not map AC4 brute B counter-as-dodge and Resynced LB parry/B dodge to a shared dispatcher until demonstrated.
A held input used to guard must not be swallowed while a timed counter/finisher/action is unknown.
Do not request owner to repeat shared-button Attack/Takedown remapping experiment.
